purpose: Bind the eventual BR204 FULL178 compact certificate to exact L>8/K8-tail-slot evidence in the same b-unit traversal, so BR205 can be decided without persisting raw states or rerunning BR204 merely for attribution.

tail_slot_semantics.L_gt_8_state: compact BC state with more than eight exact qBC levels
tail_slot_semantics.K8_tail_slot: for L>8, K8 parts 1..7 are exact and part 8 contains exact level 8 plus every deeper-level multiplicity evaluated at q8
tail_slot_semantics.warning: tail-slot multiplicity is not identical to multiplicity from levels strictly greater than 8; the L>8 state predicate is what localizes possible K8-vs-FULL slack

per_b_invariants: all attribution fields are computed in the same streamed b unit before raw state data are discarded
L<=8 and L>8 partition compact BC base states exactly
all L<=8 states are exact under K8 and therefore have zero K8-vs-FULL truncation slack by construction
mu attribution is a subset of the corresponding K8 attribution
parent_union_requirements: sum every attribution field exactly across all 97 b units
prove 97-unit coverage and H96 refined-state/assignment-mass conservation
retain deterministic per-b stream digests and one global bin-stream digest
solve one exact rational LP only after unioning all b-unit capacities
group equal exact s/B ratios before forced-tail computation so tail activity cannot depend on bin ordering

BR205_gate_semantics.bounded_half: PASS_PREPARATORY_EVIDENCE: deeper qBC strictly improves the identical bounded population and all bounded K8-vs-FULL slack is localized to L>8
BR205_gate_semantics.full178_raw_half_candidate: positive exact FULL178 L>8 base/mass evidence plus positive K8 L>8 and tail-slot raw objective contribution
BR205_gate_semantics.full178_stronger_candidate: raw half candidate plus positive forced-selected tail-slot capacity after equal-ratio classes are merged in the exact global mu LP
BR205_gate_semantics.promotion_rule: Neither candidate authorizes BR205 until the BR204 heavy result is hostile-audited and the transition is explicitly recorded.

execution.storage_rule: persist compact b-unit bin streams/counters only under the execution-contract pilot and hard caps
